Do we have: Complete Lattice & Multi-Particle Dynamics
•	Inter-filament interactions, excited states, and scattering amplitudes for arbitrary particles.
2.	Full Quantization of $\theta_4$ & $u^\mu$ Fields
•	SAT-X treats these mostly classically with topological quantization; a fully quantum field theory with renormalization is not formalized.
3.	Dynamic Cosmology / Large-Scale Limits
•	Hubble tension, dark matter fraction, and photon-neutrino conversion are qualitatively described, but the full SAT-X cosmology equations aren’t fully solved.
4.	Unified SAT/SAT-X Notation & Constants
•	Need to merge SAT-X’s $\psi, T, \mathcal{L}_{\rm BGT}$ formalism with the newer SAT Lagrangian, topological fusion, and geometric stress-energy to produce a single consistent chassis.
5.	Numerical Implementations / Predictions
•	Actual computation of particle masses, interactions, gravitational effects, and cosmology from filament parameters is implied but not carried out explicitly.
